title: Interesting Idea: Programming Issues
review:
This app could work for young individuals with neurodivergent minds, except for a few issues:

1) the layout is inconsistent across devices; our phones show a different resolution from our tablet

2) navigation is not intuitive 

3) getting to support is a bit confusing and cumbersome

4) instructions for interacting with updated content is not accurately reflected in the “faq” or other “how-to” guides

This company could benefit from a bit more oversight and clearer communication. 

Overall, this is a promising product; but I question where the subscription cost is going.

author: Michael Bishop

title: Thank you for keeping my neurodivergent family on task
review:
We downloaded this app two weeks ago after reviewing chore apps/allowance trackers and this has exceeded all expectations so far. The chores are easy to customize for nearly every need. The only thing that would be nice (that I believe they are working on) is an option to set up the chore to show pending “until completed”. Sometimes deadlines need to be flexible so motivation isn’t lost. 

My ADHD 8yo LOVES the instant gratification of points upon completion of chores (after parent approval if set up as such!). I can tell if it going to be an awesome tool for teaching money-sense too. You can save points, redeem them for rewards, give them to other family members and also cash them out. 

As if the chores features were not enough, I LOVE the newly implemented “Do this…Don’t do that” section where you can customize bonuses and penalties. I use this section to track behavior. Things like “Don’t interrupt” or “Help your brother with something” don’t really fit in the chore section where they’re assigned to family members or put on a schedule or due at any specific time. 

The admin team is actively present on the community page and responds to questions and requests about the app regularly. Keep up the good work, y’all!!!
author: slsaggie

title: We are really enjoying this!
review:
Our family is loving to have a creative and fun platform to make goals as a family, communicate and, work together to take care of all the daily needs. 

I like that you can tailor the goals to fit your family style. My kids want to save up to go on special hikes and go camping… which are all the things I really want to do with them, but sometimes become difficult while just trying to get all of the chores done and take care of the family and our baby with special needs. Smaller goals look like a tub of ice cream, for an ice cream night.

The kids seem to be more understanding of the why behind the chores, and want to work together as we all want to go do these fun things! My incentives will look different than other families but, I love that we have that option to makes the goals to work toward that fit our individual families :) Well done app developers!

author: Kaemi Nicole

title: Torn between the pros and cons
review:
I really do like this app, I like the functionality and what it’s built to do makes managing chores within the family SO much easier. Where it fails? 1. The load/refresh rate is terribly slow. I nearly always have to kill the app on my phone before I open it again, or it will not refresh to show changes made by family. 2. My kid doesn’t have a phone so the app is on the tablet.. it is not very tablet friendly. Sits in an odd rectangular shape in the very center of the screen. 3. If I made a change to an existing chore, it doesn’t save in the chore listing but the change is there if I edit again. Example: I create a chore but realize I want a different color/icon or I don’t want a due time.. I edit it but everytime I see it in the chore listing it’s always the original color and set-up. The only thing that has changed is the name. 4. The customer service is non-existent. I have submitted two “tickets” with follow-up and I don’t even get an acknowledgment from their end. I’ve also tried to post under suggestions or in the community section and my posts never show up. 5. If my kid puts their s’mores into a reward to save, it doesn’t allow me to move them back to the bank. I have to use their account/tablet. I should be able to do this from my own. 6. There are some features/ideas that I had on things to help or things I wish the app did but there’s no one to listen.

Oh yes and there are no icons for couch, living room, sweeping, etc. Things I feel are common and you can’t add your own.

title: Not intuitive
review: I tried twice to set this up and make it work for my family but it ended up making me crazy and want to throw my phone across the room.Not easy to figure out how to assign individual chores to each person and not have them on everybody’s list. Couldn’t figure out how to rotate them. Couldn’t figure out how to take off an inane pre-populated task like wash your hands, which might be great for preschoolers but are they really using a phone to track their chores? I was hoping to use this with older kids who have their own phones and they don’t need to be reminded to wash their hands.Maybe this is a great app if I was willing to devote more time to actually figuring it out but it frustrated me so much trying to set it up that I didn’t want to try.
